entry.name: Configure chunking
entry.keywords: chunk chunks chunking group grouping words at a time several multiple phrase adaptive fixed
entry.description: Flash several words at once instead of one at a time, so your eyes move less across each flash. Opens a window where you can turn this on for the transcript open now or for new transcripts, pick a fixed number of words or an adaptive width, and set the size.
texts: Configure chunking…

Flash several words at once instead of one at a time, so your eyes move less across each flash. Opens a window where you can turn this on for the transcript open now or for new transcripts, pick a fixed number of words or an adaptive width, and set the size.

entry.name: Configure speaker cues
entry.keywords: speaker speakers cue cues who is talking voice interview dialogue conversation name tag flash chime sound bell
entry.description: In transcripts with names at the start of their lines, like "Interviewer:", show who is speaking and give a cue when the speaker changes: a name tag, a brief flash and, on Windows, a soft chime. Opens a window where you can turn this on, pick the cues and the sound, and check the speakers found in the transcript open now.

entry.description: Adds a fixed grey line above and below the vertical guide marks, sized close to the width of the reading area, to help keep your eyes centered while reading.

entry.name: Slow down for long words
entry.keywords: length long pacing pause delay timing longer pace speed
entry.description: Gives longer words a bit more time on screen, in three steps based on length (short words are unaffected). If a word is both long and ends a sentence or clause, only the longer of the two pauses applies, since they don't stack. Applies globally, takes effect after clicking Apply.
texts: Slow down for long words

Gives longer words a bit more time on screen, in three steps based on length (short words are unaffected). If a word is both long and ends a sentence or clause, only the longer of the two pauses applies, since they don't stack. Applies globally, takes effect after clicking Apply.

entry.name: Ease in at the start of reading
entry.keywords: warm up warmup warm-up ramp gradually slow start half speed build up begin
entry.description: Starts each reading session at about half speed and builds up to your chosen speed over the first several words, so you settle in instead of being hit with full speed right away. It stacks with the pacing above. Applies globally, to the main and detached windows, and takes effect after clicking Apply.
texts: Ease in at the start of reading

entry.name: Split long paragraphs when normalizing
entry.keywords: normalize normalise paragraphs break wall of text sentences edit box layout
entry.description: When you click Normalize, also break a long wall of text into paragraphs at sentence ends, so it's easier to read in the edit box. This only changes how the text is laid out for editing, never what gets read or the reading speed. Applies globally; takes effect the next time you click Normalize.
texts: Split long paragraphs when normalizing

entry.name: Rewind a few words when resuming
entry.keywords: back step back replay context resume pause words to rewind on resume
entry.description: When you resume after pausing, reading first steps back this many words, so you pick up with a little context instead of exactly where you stopped. Applies globally, to the main and detached windows. Allowed range: 1 to 5. Takes effect after clicking Apply, and only while the toggle above is on.
texts: Rewind a few words when resuming
Words to rewind on resume:

entry.name: Pause after using the scrubber
entry.keywords: scrub scrubber progress bar seek drag jump position slider stop
entry.description: When you drag the progress bar to a new spot and let go, reading pauses there, so you can get your bearings before pressing play. Turn this off to have reading keep going from the new spot if it was already playing. Applies globally, to the main and detached windows, and takes effect after clicking Apply.
texts: Pause after using the scrubber

entry.name: Show surrounding words
entry.keywords: peripheral context ribbon sentence before after dim line neighbours neighbors nearby
entry.description: Shows a dim line beneath the flashing word with the words just before and after it, so you keep a little sense of the sentence around what you're reading without your eyes leaving the centre. Applies globally, to the main and detached windows, and takes effect after clicking Apply.
texts: Show surrounding words

entry.name: Reopen the last transcript at launch
entry.keywords: start startup open launch previous last remember resume restore session continue
entry.description: When the app starts, it opens the transcript that was open when you last closed it, at the same word and paused, so nothing starts playing on its own. Turn this off to start with no transcript open. Takes effect the next time you launch the app.
texts: Reopen the last transcript at launch
